rules.name: FLY FAST AS THOUGHT
rules.text: When you Gather or Push [Beasts] , they may come from or go to lands up to 2 distant (rather than adjacent only) .
rules.turn:
push S B From, spirit:special S fly-fast, beasts-at B From,
  adjacent From M, adjacent M To, neq From To, land-for power To
  / push-dest S B From To
rules.evidence: push-dest rows for the swarm in l3: l2 (base) and l1 (two away, added)
rules.notes: Push is written with an explicit destination relation keyed by who pushes, so a Spirit can add destinations. Needed a hand-written `neq` (#js-def) because Turn has no symbol inequality. Gather is not modeled.

rules.name: A JOINING OF SWARMS AND FLOCKS
rules.text: Your [Sacred Site] may also count as [Beasts] . (Note: You never have more than 1 [Sacred Site] in a land, no matter how many [Presence] you have there.) (If something changes a [Beasts] that is your [Sacred Site] , it affects 2 of your [Presence] there - e.g., Push 1 [Beasts] will Push 2 of your [Presence] together.)
rules.evidence: move-pair mm l3 l1 -> move m1 l1, move m2 l1; destroy of the swarm -> destroy-pair mm l3 -> two Presence destroyed
rules.notes: One virtual Beasts per Sacred Site, and two exceptions turn "move/destroy that Beasts" into "move/destroy 2 Presence". "May" count, chosen per piece and per Action (FAQ), is not modeled: the swarm always counts. Doing it properly needs a choice at the start of every Action that reads Beasts, and Turn has no hook for that.

language_issues: No built-in inequality on symbols; needed `#js-def neq +A +B { if (JSON.stringify(A) !== JSON.stringify(B)) yield [] }`.
Optional "counts as", chosen per Action, needs a choice at the start of every Action that reads the counted type, and there is no hook for that.
